correctness.rationale: The three nonzero Klein-four edge colours are a cocycle/flow at each cubic vertex and therefore integrate to uniquely normalized face labels on the sphere. The explicit rim/spoke XOR formulas classify every labelled colouring and isolate the only nonzero-bottom exceptional state. Each complete two-colour Kempe cycle is precisely the boundary of one nonmissing-letter run, except the two whole rim cycles in the alternating case. This gives a bijection of complete adjacency graphs, not only degree counts. Five explicit states form a cycle for both parities and prefix-padding preserves each internal maximal run. Earlier Belcastro-Haas 2017 Proposition 2.1 excludes triangles; this establishes odd girth five at all n>=5. Complete independent adjacency comparisons n=3..12 and witness tests n=5..60 passed. Tests alone are not invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2017 paper explicitly identified the absence of a proof for the ordinary-prism fixed-vertex Kempe graph structure; a complete, natural all-size cycle-word description addresses that motivated gap. It proves a sharp odd-girth phase and exhibits a five-cycle even for bipartite prisms; unlike routine degree counts, it specifies every permitted reconfiguration move and is reusable for exact graph invariants.
